question: What is the meaning of disassembly instructions in relation to circularity potential?
description: Dismantling instructions in relation to circularity potential refer to the guidance provided on how to take a product apart in a way that allows some parts to be reused or recycled. This information is crucial for achieving a higher level of reused and recycled content from end-of-life products, contributing to the overall circularity potential of the product.
